description: This Java class `MqttPublishTarget` represents an MQTT publish target with a specific topic. It includes methods for creating instances, retrieving the topic, and overrides for equality, hash code, and string representation.

classes.name: MqttPublishTarget
classes.description: An immutable class representing an MQTT publish target with a specific topic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of MqttPublishTarget with the specified topic.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves the MQTT topic associated with this publish target.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equals method to compare MqttPublishTarget instances based on their topics.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides hashCode to generate hash based on the topic.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MqttPublishTarget.
